title: Board / Column / Card Domain Model + Store
description: Typed board/column/card domain model and a client-side store holding the active board, all boards, columns, and cards with explicit ordering arrays (columnOrder / cardOrder) so drag-and-drop is deterministic.
spec:
1. Define TypeScript types Board { id, name, columnOrder: string[] }, Column { id, boardId, name, cardOrder: string[] }, Card { id, columnId, title, description?, labels: string[], createdAt, updatedAt }
2. Verify all id fields are string (uuid or crypto.randomUUID) and unique
3. Implement a store (Zustand or React context per spec/project.md) exposing normalized entities keyed by id plus ordering arrays
4. Verify the store exposes actions to add/update/remove boards, columns, and cards without mutating state in place
5. Verify columnOrder and cardOrder are the single source of truth for ordering (no implicit sort)
6. Verify no `any` types are used (AGENTS.md zero-tolerance) and strict mode compiles
7. Verify a selector can resolve the active board -> its columns in order -> each column's cards in order
8. Add a default seed board (e.g. To Do / Doing / Done) used when no persisted state exists
9. Verify adding a card appends its id to the target column cardOrder
10. Verify removing a column removes its id from board columnOrder and does not orphan card entities
11. Verify removing a card removes its id from the owning column cardOrder
12. Verify `bun run typecheck` and `bun run build` pass
